notes.title: Great News - Peanut on Sale!
notes.notes:
Great News! PEANUT is on a MASSIVE 60% SALE! Get your corgi retro on while you can! 

Take yourself back to a better time when games were not as polished as they are now. 

Try and figure out what the corgi is going on in this game! Either play the game at face value or figure out more of the story from the visuals. 

Win your corgi BAE back from the Evil Veronica Vet!

If you remember Super Mario Bros or Duck Tails you may get a kick out of this hair brained game! 

Be prepared for a trip back to the past, start with conventional levels and then it all goes sideways!
